picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first Genesis Mission awards signals DOE is putting real money behind AI-accelerated science at the Electron-Ion Collider — a bellwether for how the national labs plan to fund AI research going forward.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: An agentic AI that can autonomously design, run, and interpret its own experiments — developed with DOE and SLAC backing — is a concrete step toward self-driving labs, one of the most consequential near-term applications of AI in science.
picks.title: This AI scientist can run experiments. Self-driving labs coming next

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's DUNE collaboration weaving AI/ML into neutrino detector operations shows AI moving from a research tool into core infrastructure for one of the world's flagship particle physics experiments.
picks.title: DUNE uses AI to transform the future of neutrino research

picks.editorial_note: TUM alumni's HappyRobot crossing a $1B valuation as the university's 23rd unicorn is a striking data point on how directly academic AI talent is converting into major commercial value.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial proteomics could meaningfully improve cancer treatment prediction by modeling tumor tissue organization across cancer types — a high-value application of AI in medicine.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: A deployable ML framework that predicts hardware behavior in the DIII-D tokamak has direct implications for fusion energy research, one of the highest-stakes domains where AI-driven control could accelerate progress.
picks.title: Blending Fusion Science, AI to Predict DIII-D Tokamak Behavior

picks.editorial_note: MIT and Tsinghua's GeoPT approach teaches AI simulators physical intuition via virtual mechanical interactions, a methodological advance that could broaden how reliably AI models generalize to real-world physics.
picks.title: With a feel for physics, AI models simulate a wider range of real-world scenarios

picks.editorial_note: A $12M Army Research Lab grant for animal-inspired sensing systems is a substantial defense-funded bet on AI-powered autonomous drones and robots, with clear real-world deployment implications.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: A 113-page synthesis of 500+ studies proposing a unified framework for self-improving language models is a significant contribution to understanding where frontier AI capability research is headed.
picks.title: Stony Brook Researchers Create a Blueprint for Self-Improving Language Models - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: Haim Sompolinsky's Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics work underpinning neural network theory, underscoring how deeply AI's theoretical roots are now being honored at the highest levels of physics.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal
